description: The file 'Delete.php' handles the deletion of inbound email records in the SuiteCRM system. It validates the request, retrieves the specific inbound email bean, clears its folder subscriptions, marks the record as deleted, and then redirects the user to a specified location.

classes.name: SugarFolder
classes.description: A class responsible for managing email folder subscriptions, specifically with a method to clear subscriptions for a given folder.

classes.name: InboundEmail
classes.description: Bean class representing inbound email records in the application.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Fetches a record from the database corresponding to the provided ID.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Marks a specific record as deleted in the database.
